data.title: Order to cut back your hedge
data.summary: The district office (Landratsamt Beispielkreis) ordered you on 29 June 2026 to cut your hedge back to the property boundary because it extends up to 1.20 m into the pavement. The work is to be done within three weeks after the decision becomes final.
data.explanation: The authority says your hedge along the district road RO 5 blocks the pavement and the view at the junction, and requires you to cut it back to your property line. You may either comply or file an objection (Widerspruch) against this decision. The app shows until when the objection can be filed. If you don't object in time, the decision becomes final (Bestandskraft), and the three-week period for the work starts then. If unsure whether to object, consider getting professional advice.

items.title: File objection against hedge order

date.text: binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist

items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or on record at the Landratsamt Beispielkreis.
items.consequence: Without an objection in time, the order becomes final and binding.
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch

items.title: Cut hedge back to property boundary

date.text: innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids

items.action: Cut the hedge back to the property boundary within three weeks after the order becomes final (Bestandskraft).
items.quote: Wir bitten um Erledigung innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids.
